stories.title: Flintshire Council’s new transformation plan warns things look “bleak”
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has admitted that further cuts to its workforce could push services to “unsafe” levels, as it publishes a three-year strategy setting out how it plans to save money and change the way it operates. stories.title: Police warn south Flintshire drivers after vehicle crime reports
stories.summary: North Wales Police has issued a warning to drivers in south Flintshire after a number of reports of suspicious activity around parked vehicles, including car door handles being tried in the early hours of the morning. stories.title: Flintshire Council rejects two-storey glamping pod plan at Cilcain
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has refused a bid to turn two glamping pods into two-storey buildings at a farm in Cilcain, in the Clwydian Range Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty. stories.title: Five candidates confirmed for Higher Kinnerton by-election
stories.summary: A by-election will be held in Higher Kinnerton on Thursday 15 October to elect a new Flintshire County Council county councillor. The vote follows the resignation of Mike Allport, who held the seat as an Independent. Five candidates have been confirmed as validly nominated by returning officer Neal Cockerton. stories.title: Diocese decision to allow Flintshire taxpayers to fund new school branded ‘unfair’
stories.summary: Opponents of Flintshire’s Catholic super-school plans have reacted with anger after it emerged the Diocese of Wrexham made a financial contribution to a new school in Gwynedd.
